# Noravelle Stays

> Noravelle Stays publishes editorial luxury and boutique hotel guides for US cities. Each guide names hotels and links to their official websites. Prices are not invented.

## Hotel guides by city

- [Hotel guides](https://noravellestays.com/hotels/): City pages with neighborhood notes and named hotel picks that link to official hotel websites.
- [Austin hotels](https://noravellestays.com/hotels/austin/): Best luxury hotels in Austin for 2026, with South Congress, downtown, Lady Bird Lake, Rainey Street, East Austin, and a Hancock estate, and nine official website links. Updated 23 Oct 2026.
- [Charleston hotels](https://noravellestays.com/hotels/charleston/): Best boutique hotels in downtown Charleston for 2026, with the French Quarter, King Street, South of Broad, Mount Pleasant, and Kiawah, and official website links. Updated 23 Oct 2026.
- [Columbus hotels](https://noravellestays.com/hotels/columbus/): Short North boutiques, downtown towers, and Easton area hotels, with official website links.
- [Denver hotels](https://noravellestays.com/hotels/denver/): LoDo, Union Station, Cherry Creek, RiNo, the Golden Triangle, and the Theatre District, with nine official website links. Updated 20 Oct 2026.
- [Jacksonville hotels](https://noravellestays.com/hotels/jacksonville/): Ponte Vedra Beach, TPC Sawgrass, Atlantic Beach, Amelia Island, downtown, and LaVilla, with official website links.
- [Kansas City hotels](https://noravellestays.com/hotels/kansas-city/): Best hotels in Kansas City for 2026, with the Country Club Plaza, the Crossroads, and Power and Light, and nine official website links. Updated 25 Oct 2026.
- [Miami hotels](https://noravellestays.com/hotels/miami/): South Beach, Mid Beach, Surfside, Brickell, Coconut Grove, Coral Gables, and Key Biscayne, with official website links.
- [Nashville hotels](https://noravellestays.com/hotels/nashville/): Best hotels in Nashville for 2026, including luxury downtown stays, a boutique hotel near the Gulch, and Germantown as a dinner outing, with 13 official website links. Updated 24 Oct 2026.
- [New Orleans hotels](https://noravellestays.com/hotels/new-orleans/): Best luxury hotels in New Orleans for 2026, including French Quarter courtyards, the Warehouse District, and the Garden District, with official website links. Updated 23 Oct 2026.
- [Raleigh hotels](https://noravellestays.com/hotels/raleigh/): Best hotels in Raleigh for 2026, with downtown, Glenwood South, the Warehouse District, North Hills, and a Cary spa, and nine official website links. Updated 25 Oct 2026.
- [San Antonio hotels](https://noravellestays.com/hotels/san-antonio/): Best hotels in San Antonio for 2026, with the River Walk, the Pearl District, and King William, and nine official website links. Updated 24 Oct 2026.
- [Savannah hotels](https://noravellestays.com/hotels/savannah/): Historic District squares, riverfront hotels, and calmer South Historic edges, with official website links.
- [Tampa hotels](https://noravellestays.com/hotels/tampa/): Water Street, Hyde Park, Ybor City, and downtown picks, with official website links.

## Where to stay guides

- [Guides](https://noravellestays.com/guides/): Where to stay notes and weekend pacing, with links to hotel pages and official site picks.
- [How we pick luxury hotels](https://noravellestays.com/guides/how-we-pick-luxury-hotels/): Neighborhood first, then fit, then an honest limit on what the edit can claim. Official websites come first.
- [Where to stay in Austin](https://noravellestays.com/guides/where-to-stay-in-austin/): Best places to stay by neighborhood: South Congress, Lady Bird Lake, Rainey Street, and quieter bases, with official hotel links. Updated October 2026.
- [Where to stay in Charleston](https://noravellestays.com/guides/where-to-stay-in-charleston/): Best places to stay by neighborhood: French Quarter, quieter houses, Upper King, and the harbor block, with official hotel links. Updated October 2026.
- [Where to stay in Miami](https://noravellestays.com/guides/where-to-stay-in-miami/): Miami Beach, Brickell, and quieter Coral Gables or Coconut Grove.
- [Where to stay in Nashville](https://noravellestays.com/guides/where-to-stay-in-nashville/): Best places to stay by neighborhood: the Gulch, downtown off Broadway, SoBro, and a quieter night, with official hotel links. Updated October 2026.
- [Where to stay in New Orleans](https://noravellestays.com/guides/where-to-stay-in-new-orleans/): Best places to stay by neighborhood: the French Quarter off Bourbon, the Warehouse District, and the Garden District, with official hotel links. Updated October 2026.

## Weekend trips and day plans

- [Austin weekend](https://noravellestays.com/guides/austin-weekend-trip/): A South Congress or downtown base, one destination dinner, and buffers for festival traffic.
- [Charleston weekend](https://noravellestays.com/guides/charleston-weekend-trip/): A Historic District boutique base, one destination dinner, and wedding season inventory notes.
- [Denver weekend](https://noravellestays.com/guides/denver-weekend-trip/): A LoDo or Cherry Creek base, altitude aware pacing, and one destination dinner.
- [Nashville weekend](https://noravellestays.com/guides/nashville-weekend-trip/): A Gulch or Music Row base, one Broadway night if you want it, and quieter dining otherwise.
- [Savannah weekend](https://noravellestays.com/guides/savannah-weekend-trip/): A Historic District boutique or courtyard inn, with noise filters near River Street.
- [Day plans](https://noravellestays.com/day-plans/): Illustrated one day itineraries paired with hotel picks and official website links.
- [Austin South Congress day](https://noravellestays.com/day-plans/austin-south-congress-day/): South Congress in the morning, Lady Bird Lake in the afternoon, dinner on South Congress or downtown.
- [Charleston Historic District day](https://noravellestays.com/day-plans/charleston-historic-day/): The Battery in the morning, City Market and King Street in the afternoon, a waterfront or courtyard evening.
- [Miami Beach day](https://noravellestays.com/day-plans/miami-beach-luxury-day/): A quieter morning beach, an Art Deco afternoon, and dinner in South Beach or Brickell.
- [Nashville day](https://noravellestays.com/day-plans/nashville-evening-luxury/): A Gulch or Centennial Park morning, one museum or a hotel pool in the afternoon, and one Broadway evening window.
- [New Orleans Garden District day](https://noravellestays.com/day-plans/new-orleans-garden-district-day/): Garden District and Magazine Street by day, and the French Quarter in the evening.

## Holiday and event travel

- [Holiday and event travel](https://noravellestays.com/travel/): Dated guides for Thanksgiving 2026, Travel Tuesday 2026, Christmas and New Year 2026 to 2027, the Rockefeller Center tree lighting, the 2027 Winter Classic, MLK weekend 2027, spring break 2027, the Ryder Cup at Adare Manor, ski pass deadlines for 2026 to 2027, and Super Bowl LXI hotels in Los Angeles. No invented rates.
- [Super Bowl LXI 2027 hotels](https://noravellestays.com/super-bowl-lxi-2027-hotels/): Sunday 14 February 2027 at SoFi Stadium in Inglewood. Hotels by area, free flow and estimated drive times, On Location hotel prices as listed on 30 Oct 2026, and NFL Ticket Exchange status. Kickoff time is not in the event schema because SoFi Stadium still said Time TBA.
- [Super Bowl Valentine's weekend in Los Angeles](https://noravellestays.com/travel/valentines-weekend-los-angeles-2027/): A couples shape for 12 to 15 February 2027. Hotel prices stay on the Super Bowl guide.
- [Travel Tuesday 2026](https://noravellestays.com/travel-tuesday-2026/): Tuesday 1 December 2026. Flight and hotel offers are added as they are announced. None are confirmed yet. Includes a fare baseline checklist and a browser tracker with no sample prices. Updated 28 Oct 2026.
- [Best days to fly Thanksgiving 2026](https://noravellestays.com/travel/thanksgiving-2026/): Expected peak days for flying and driving, book by guidance, and luxury hotel angles in cities the site covers. Last updated 27 Oct 2026.
- [Christmas travel 2026](https://noravellestays.com/travel/christmas-travel-2026/): Christmas Day and New Year's Day timing, festive stays, New Year's Eve neighborhood ideas, and a link to the Winter Classic guide.
- [Rockefeller tree lighting 2026](https://noravellestays.com/travel/rockefeller-tree-lighting-2026/): The tree is lit Wednesday 2 December 2026, from 7 to 10 p.m. ET. Lighting night, hotels a short walk from Rockefeller Center, a 3 night December shape, and the best week to visit. Facts checked on rockefellercenter.com and NBC. Updated 27 Oct 2026.
- [Epic Pass deadlines and luxury ski hotels, 2026 to 2027](https://noravellestays.com/travel/epic-pass-deadlines-2026/): Epic prices rise after 15 November 2026. Ikon and Mountain Collective deadlines, resort opening days, and verified ski in, ski out hotels. Prices as of 27 Oct 2026. No invented rates.
- [Winter Classic 2027 in Salt Lake City](https://noravellestays.com/travel/winter-classic-2027-salt-lake-city/): Mammoth versus Avalanche at Rice-Eccles Stadium on 31 December 2026, with verified hotels, UTA, and New Year's Eve limits. No resale prices.
- [MLK weekend 2027](https://noravellestays.com/travel/mlk-weekend-2027/): Monday 18 January 2027 luxury long weekend ideas in cities the site already covers, with book by guidance.
- [Spring break 2027 luxury destinations](https://noravellestays.com/travel/spring-break-2027/): An approximate window around Easter Sunday 28 March 2027, with a luxury shortlist and a separate note on party trips.
- [Ryder Cup 2027 Adare Manor hotels](https://noravellestays.com/travel/ryder-cup-2027-adare-manor/): Official dates, ticket and hospitality channels, Ireland logistics, and lodging cautions. Availability and prices stay on the official sites. Ticket status reread 27 Oct 2026.

## About and policies

- [About](https://noravellestays.com/about/): Noravelle Stays publishes curated luxury and boutique US stay guides.
- [Contact](https://noravellestays.com/contact/): How to message Noravelle Stays. The site does not book hotels or take payment.
- [How we recommend](https://noravellestays.com/how-pricing-works/): How hotel picks and affiliate commissions work. Official websites come first, and there are no invented undercut claims.
- [Affiliate disclosure](https://noravellestays.com/affiliate-disclosure/): A partner booking may earn a commission, at no extra cost to you.
- [Privacy](https://noravellestays.com/privacy/): How contact form information is handled.
- [Terms](https://noravellestays.com/terms/): Rules for using the site, including that bookings happen on other sites.
- [Disclaimer](https://noravellestays.com/disclaimer/): Guides are general information, not live prices or a travel agency booking service.
- [Resources](https://noravellestays.com/resources/): Planning notes and the luxury hotel trends brief.
- [US luxury hotel trends](https://noravellestays.com/resources/us-luxury-hotel-trends/): A 2026 brief on US luxury and boutique hotel demand, with public sources and no invented rate tables.
